findings.title: Direct LLM API Invocations Bypassing Model Router

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral bypassing the central model router endpoint

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM synthesis requests through the model router service

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes model routing, failover mechanisms, and latency/cost tracking
